criteria.name: Info and relationships
criteria.evidence: DOM of Open: the trigger and its wrapper carry no aria-describedby while the tooltip is shown (aria is set to expanded false only)
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): let Tippy set aria-describedby (aria content auto). IconTooltip sets it itself.

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast passes on Open, LongContent and RTL

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll; LongContent wraps at 350px

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Content on hover or focus
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): shown on focus, Escape hides it; source: interactive, so the pointer can move onto it

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): focus on a button trigger opens it, Escape closes it
criteria.note: Only when the trigger is focusable: Default wraps a p, which Tab never reaches.

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: source: the focus ring is the trigger's, which the caller passes

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: the tooltip opens beside the trigger and leaves it visible

criteria.name: Target size (minimum)
criteria.evidence: source: the target is the caller's trigger

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: DOM of Open: the trigger and its wrapper carry no aria-describedby while the tooltip is shown (aria is set to expanded false only); the box has role tooltip
criteria.note: Fixed by the same heal as 1.3.1.
